|errata_history={{Card errata/Aurra Sing With Blaster Rifle (ALT)}}
This is version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2, in date order) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is the current version. The image is the PC card image of this version ([[:File:V12-D-aurrasingwithblasterrifle_ai.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing of the Alternate Image (ALT) card; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and a re-made image is its own version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Aurra Sing With Blaster Rifle (ALT)]], 2 March 2021): PC card image uploaded 2 March 2021<ref name="ht-aurra-ai-2021">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/aurrasingwithblasterrifleai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/34f907fa4a789493c19f364dcd74cc459d403863 commit 34f907f] (2 March 2021) (“Aurra Sing with Blaster Rifle AI”): [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/34f907fa4a789493c19f364dcd74cc459d403863/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/aurrasingwithblasterrifleai.gif aurrasingwithblasterrifleai.gif]. Renamed unchanged to <code>aurrasingwithblasterrifle_ai.gif</code> on 11 August 2021 (commit 237def4). The commit date is the upload date.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; copyright line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd”; lore “Bounty hunter. Assassin.” Text: “Permanent weapon is •Aurra Sing's Blaster Rifle (may target a character for free; if targeting a Jedi, draw two destiny, otherwise draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny +1 > defense value).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 20 February 2023): PC card image uploaded 20 February 2023<ref name="ht-aurra-ai-2023">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/aurrasingwithblasterrifle_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image), [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8c98fe01d3ac031d5566804ae7b40eb914913525 commit 8c98fe0] (20 February 2023) (“Set 12 Remastered”); card-size copy [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/9e3d9929eb170ded7c439b48f806e67eb656faf7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/aurrasingwithblasterrifle_ai.gif aurrasingwithblasterrifle_ai.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9e3d9929eb170ded7c439b48f806e67eb656faf7 9e3d992] (20 February 2023). The commit date is the upload date.</ref>, mark “E1”. Text: “Permanent weapon is •Aurra Sing's Blaster Rifle (may target a character for free; if targeting a Jedi, draw two destiny, otherwise draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny +1 > defense value).” '''What changed''' (compared with the image of 2 March 2021): the card was re-made as part of the Virtual Set 12 remaster. The lore “Bounty hunter. Assassin.” became “Female bounty hunter and assassin.”; the copyright line became “© 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.”; the card now prints the errata mark “E1”. The game text words are the same. It is the current image.
